test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following services have been integrated into the newly revamped Mission Vatsalya Portal launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development in July 2025?

options.text: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Childline 1098
Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana and Sakhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**TrackChild and Khoya-Paya Services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mission Vatsalya Portal** is a comprehensive platform launched by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** to protect and rehabilitate children in need of care and protection.
 
• In **July 2025**, the newly revamped portal integrated several services, including **TrackChild** and **Khoya-Paya**, which are key tools for tracking missing children and ensuring their safety.
 
• **TrackChild**: This initiative is a nationwide tracking system that helps in locating missing children and linking them with their families or providing them institutional care.
 
• **Khoya-Paya Services**: This is an online citizen-based platform to report and track missing and found children, encouraging public participation in child welfare.
 
• Other schemes like **Poshan Abhiyaan**, **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao**, and **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana** are critical government initiatives, but they are not directly integrated into the Mission Vatsalya Portal. *Hence, options 1, 2, and 4 are incorrect.*
 
• The integration of **TrackChild** and **Khoya-Paya** services aligns with the mission's objective of ensuring a safe environment for children and expediting their rehabilitation. *Hence, option 3 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **TrackChild:**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** in partnership with the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• The platform connects stakeholders, including police, child welfare committees, and childcare institutions, to trace missing children.
 
• It features a centralized database of missing and found children, accessible to law enforcement agencies and authorized officials.
 
• Parents and guardians can also register complaints and track updates about their missing children.
 
 
 
• **Khoya-Paya Services:**
 
 
• Launched in **2015** by the Government of India, this citizen-centric platform enables people to report missing or found children.
 
• It serves as a bridge between the public and government authorities, accelerating the process of locating children.
 
• The platform uses technology to disseminate information quickly, increasing the chances of reuniting children with their families.
 
• It complements the **TrackChild** initiative by mobilizing community support for child welfare.
 
 
 
• **Mission Vatsalya:**
 
 
• This is an umbrella scheme aimed at **child protection, welfare, and development**, focusing on children in difficult circumstances.
 
• It emphasizes strengthening the child protection system, institutional care, and non-institutional care, such as adoption and foster care.
 
• The program also promotes awareness and participation among stakeholders and communities to safeguard children's rights.
 
 
 
• **Other Integrated Child Protection Services (ICPS):**
 
 
• ICPS was merged into Mission Vatsalya to create a unified framework for child protection in India.
 
• It includes services like open shelters, child helplines, and sponsorships to aid vulnerable children.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Childline 1098:** This is a toll-free helpline service for children in distress, operational under the Mission Vatsalya framework.
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** This scheme focuses on gender equality and improving the survival and education of the girl child, but it is not directly integrated into the portal.
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan:** It addresses malnutrition and is aimed at improving the nutritional outcomes for children and women but operates independently of Mission Vatsalya.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana:** A maternity benefit program for pregnant women and lactating mothers, providing conditional cash transfers, but it is separate from the Mission Vatsalya Portal's scope.
